# IVANNIKOV.PRO Studio Portal — Telegram Mini App

> Closed client portal for IVANNIKOV.PRO engineering studio. Runs only inside the Telegram client at `@ivannikovProBot/app`. For studio info (services, portfolio, blog), see `ivannikov.pro`.

This URL (`tg.ivannikov.pro`) hosts the static SPA bundle for the Telegram Mini App. It is not designed for direct browser access — Telegram WebView is the only supported runtime. Outside Telegram, screens render but `initData` auth, `MainButton`, `BackButton`, and haptic feedback are no-op; the app shows fallback CTAs but cannot complete actions tied to a Telegram user identity.

## Where to find the studio (main site)

- [ivannikov.pro](https://ivannikov.pro): services, portfolio, process, blog, contact, CV
- [ivannikov.pro/llms.txt](https://ivannikov.pro/llms.txt): full AI-readable index of the main site
- [ivannikov.pro/llms-full.txt](https://ivannikov.pro/llms-full.txt): full content of the main site for LLM consumption

## Entry points

- [Telegram bot](https://t.me/ivannikovProBot): `@ivannikovProBot` — first contact / brief intake
- [Telegram Mini App](https://t.me/ivannikovProBot/app): launches this portal inside the Telegram client
- [Mini App preview image](https://tg.ivannikov.pro/opengraph-image.jpg): 640×360 OG image used for share previews

## What the Mini App does (inside Telegram)

- Track active engagements: project status, deadlines, last update from the studio
- Project workspace per engagement: chat with Aleksandr, brief, files, invoices
- Pay invoices: USDT (TRC-20), TON, card, Telegram Stars
- Referral programme: 10% of the first invoice when an introduced founder converts

## Source

- Repository: [`ivannikov-pro`](https://github.com/ivannikov-pro) — GitHub organisation; the platform monorepo is private, this app lives in `apps/telegram-mini-app`
- Stack: Vite + React 19 + `@ivannikov-pro/ui-kit` (`telegram-mini-app` surface)
- Deploy: static SPA → branch `tg` of `ivannikov-pro/ivannikov-pro.github.io` → `tg.ivannikov.pro`
